## Northgate Clinic — account profile (Jan–Jun 2026)

**Identity note first:** "Northgate Clinic" is `ACC-1042` through 2026-03-31. On 2026-04-01 it continues as `ACC-1077`, renamed "Northgate Health Partners (formerly Northgate Clinic)" — same entity, new account_id and name, per accounts.csv's back-to-back validity windows. Everything below treats both IDs as one account.

**Month by month:**
- **Jan** — plan `standard`, billed 1,840 units / $772.80, contract `active`, 1 ticket (feature-request).
- **Feb** — contract `paused`; no billing that month (consistent with the pause). No tickets.
- **Mar** — contract back to `active`. Plan changed `standard` → `enterprise-annual`, effective 2026-03-01. Billed 1,910 units / $592.10 under the new plan. 2 tickets (feature-request, integration).
- **Apr** — renamed/re-issued as `ACC-1077`. Contract `active`. Plan `enterprise-annual`, billed 1,120 units / $347.20. 2 tickets, both billing-question.
- **May** — contract `active`. Plan `enterprise-annual`, billed 1,085 units / $336.35. 1 ticket (outage-report).
- **Jun** — no billing row, no contract-status row, no ticket for this account.

**Sequence of changes** (stated as sequence, not cause — the records don't establish why any of this happened): a one-month pause in February, a plan switch from standard to enterprise-annual on 2026-03-01, then an account rename/re-issue to ACC-1077 on 2026-04-01. Billed volume and spend fell across this window — $772.80 (Jan) → $592.10 (Mar) → $347.20 (Apr) → $336.35 (May) — overlapping with, but not shown by these records to be caused by, the plan change or rename. Ticket topics also shifted from feature-request/integration (under ACC-1042) to billing-question/outage-report (under ACC-1077), though that's only 6 tickets total, too few to call a trend.

**Two data-quality items worth flagging, not explained by these files:**
1. ACC-1077 has no billing row for June, while the other three ongoing accounts in the dataset all do — could be churn, a pause, or a missed export; contract_status.csv can't adjudicate because it has no June rows for anyone.
2. contract_status.csv is missing June entirely, for every account, not just this one — looks like a dataset-wide export gap for that source.

If you want to know *why* the pause happened, why the account was renamed/re-issued, or why June billing is missing for this account specifically, those are causal questions this exploratory pass can't settle — they'd need a follow-up investigation (e.g., checking with the billing/contracts system owners) rather than more reading of these same files.

Full working notes (sources, cross-checks, absence-semantics reasoning) are in `work/exploration-log.md`.
